item_name: Rothco Vintage Low Profile Cap - Army Veteran
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage Army Veteran Low Profile Cap is designed for comfort and durability while proudly displaying your veteran status. The military cap is constructed from long-lasting brushed cotton twill, providing a comfortable fit that’s perfect for daily wear. The front panel features raised embroidered "Veteran" text, which is also showcased on the adjustable hook & loop strap at the back. A woven American flag label on the front panel adds a patriotic touch to your everyday wear.
